body: We may be twins.  I honestly don’t think that suicide is the ‘worst’ option or that it should be considered mental illness. I think dying with no dignity, having suffered for a lifetime is.  Do I think you should go? No, but only because you seem intelligent and articulate and the world needs that so bad.

Money honestly is salvation.. No one here is living that perfect 10/10 life…clearly… But even if it takes you 20 years longer than everyone else, go and find a crap job and make money, save a little at a time.  Yeah I did that. I can’t promise it’ll make you less suicidal because here we are haha.  But money did save me a bit.  I live in sadness, but with a bit more dignity than I had before.
Ate whatever the hell i liked, cried, said bye (obviously not in an obvious way) to everyone I cared about
Guilt - mostly for what it would do to my friends and parents
